description: This file defines the internal server API interface for media decryption in Rialto, including factory and session management classes, as well as methods for decrypting media buffers and handling session states.

classes.name: IMediaKeysServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaKeysServerInternal based on key system.

classes.name: IMediaKeysServerInternal
classes.description: Interface defining the server internal API for media decryption, including methods for decrypting buffers and session management.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaKeysServerInternalFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeysServerInternal
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IMediaKeysServerInternal instance for a given key system.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted media buffer using a session ID, with a GstCaps parameter for media format info.

methods.name: decrypt (deprecated)
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted media buffer with additional parameters for subsample info, IV, key ID, and DRM-specific options.

methods.name: hasSession
methods.description: Checks if a session with the given ID is handled by this MediaKeys instance.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the session's key system is PlayReady.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Increments the usage counter for a session ID.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Decrements the usage counter for a session ID.
